coverage.reason: Repair the shared Shop timer: update purchase deadlines and exact UTC unlock, resume after ad disclosure, refresh server-confirmed ad eligibility at cooldown expiry and UTC rollover, retry failures at a bounded rate, and stop cleanly on modal exit. The new browser test drives the real interval callback at three sizes and covers every paid cap, shared Gold/Troop cooldown, stable controls, delayed/failed reads and close/reopen. Existing Shop, ad and cosmetics tests cover affected purchase, confirmation, Skins and modal lifecycle dependencies. Prices, limits and backend mutations remain unchanged.

Execute the existing client and server purchase-status functions against each configured item's cap immediately before, at and after UTC midnight; keep legacy cooldown migration coverage. This validates matching authority/display deadlines without changing server code or production records.
Record root causes, focused desktop/landscape verification, unchanged limits and the unconfigured production ad-unit limitation. Documentation makes no deployment claim.
